do: Lead with #afabe9 lavender on key words or price callouts
Keep layouts minimal — lots of negative space
Always reference scalevertise.app as the domain
Anchor copy around the $650, $400, or $900 packages
Use bold, wide display type for hero headlines
Pair with 3D mesh / particle / abstract tech visuals
White pill CTAs with dark text
dont: Reference old pricing ($300, $350 tiers — these are deprecated)
Include the agency email in any ad copy
Use more than 2-3 colors per creative
Use warm tones or lifestyle photography styles
